newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 58 bln lire of Italy 18-mo Ctz.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 58 bln lire of Italy 18-mo Ctz.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 58 billion lire of 18-month zero-coupon bills (Ctz) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper and 161 billion lire of two-year Ctzs against 250 billion on offer.

Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 7.614 trillion lire at the open auction for 18-month bills, against 2.0 trillion lire worth of paper on offer. The auction price was set at 91.85 from 91.15 at the previous Ctz sale on January 28.
It also received bids for 8.372 trillion lire of two-year Ctzs against 2.5 trillion lire on offer. The auction price was set at 89.15 against 89.25 at the previous sale.
